title: Great Dane Dog Tags: Big Tags for Big Necks | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny Great Dane dog tags for the dog people keep asking to saddle. Big tags for big necks, name and number on the back. Laser cut in Lehi, Utah. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for the dog that thinks it's a lap dog and is wrong by about 140 pounds. These say what every stranger at the dog park is already thinking.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for a dog that hits things at tail height
tough.html:
A Great Dane's tag lives at counter level, which means it has seen things. It gets dragged across the kitchen counter mid-heist, dunked in a water bowl the size of a kiddie pool, and swung into every door frame in the house. Drool does the rest.

Every tag is laser engraved, so the words are cut into the metal instead of painted on top. There's no ink to chip, peel or wash off.

Shake your head and redecorate the walls. The tag can take it.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Seven bulldogs take up about as much couch as one Dane. We've done the math, mostly while sitting on the floor.

sayings.h2: 8 Great Dane sayings for the dog that gets asked if it's a horse
sayings.lead: About the leaning, the counter heists, the tail and fleeing from a cat one-twentieth their size. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will drool, water and humidity ruin an engraved tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to wash off, peel or fade.

items.q: Can I put my Great Dane's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: How much does a Great Dane tag cost?
items.a: Tags start at $12. Your Dane will cost considerably more, but that's between you and your grocery bill.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
